description: Call this to find a form_id for get_submissions, publish_form, update_form_settings or get_webhook, or to see every form the key reaches with its status and submission count; to read the answers of one form, call get_submissions instead. Lists the forms newest first. Each form has form_id, title, status (active or paused), version, submissions (total count), endpoint, hosted_url, created_at and, for unclaimed forms, expires_at. An account key (fh_live_...) sees every form of the account; an agent key (fh_agent_...) sees only the forms it created. Requires FORMHAUS_API_KEY.
name: list_forms

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the call failed.
